title: QuickSight dashboards and OpenSearch search

kcs.statement: Amazon QuickSight (Quick Sight in the Amazon Quick suite) is a serverless business intelligence service for interactive dashboards and visualisations built from sources such as Athena, Redshift and S3.
Amazon OpenSearch Service runs managed OpenSearch clusters for full-text search and log analytics with near-real-time querying.

problem_ideas: Executives want a sales dashboard on top of Redshift with no servers: which service?
A website needs a search box with typo tolerance over 2 million product descriptions: which service?
Ops wants to search and visualise application logs from the last hour: OpenSearch or Athena?
Spot the distractor: 'QuickSight runs SQL ETL jobs.'
Match four user roles (analyst, executive, SRE, developer) to the analytics service they would open.
The exam guide lists 'Amazon Quick': explain what an answer option naming QuickSight refers to.
